title: North.cloud, which helps companies watch their cloud, AI and data spend, raised a $60M Series B led by PeakSpan Capital, taking its total funding to $67M (Chris Metinko/Axios)
summary: Chris Metinko / Axios: North.cloud, which helps companies watch their cloud, AI and data spend, raised a $60M Series B led by PeakSpan Capital, taking its total funding to $67M — North.cloud, which helps companies watch their cloud, AI and data spend, closed a $60 million Series B led by PeakSpan Capital, CEO Matt Biringer tells Axios Pro exclusively.
